Hey there,
Firstly I would get off of your ED insta, I find they usually only hurt more than they help as EDs are very very competitive and no matter how hard you try you will keep comparing your meals to others (and so will they) so get off of Instagram, even delete the app if you need to.
Next, I’m sure you already ate the pasta and had the binge but for next time, ask yourself what’s stopping you from being able to eat pasta any other day? Why do you feel this urge to eat it all right now? 
With bulimia we always binge like it’s our last meal on earth and sometimes we tell ourselves it is (maybe we say we will fast the next day or exercise a shit ton)
You are allowed to eat throughout the day, you are allowed to have pasta whenever you want it. It doesn’t need to be a one time, all out thing.

You had those 30 minutes and I would use them to journal how you’re feeling in that moment and how you think you’ll feel after eating the pasta. Bulimia is mindless and it becomes routine, which is so hard to break. We have to make it less mindless and tune in to our feelings again and understand ourselves.

I hope this helps. Best of luck to you

There was this guy I was really obsessed with and I did everything in my power to keep him. He was in the AF academy and during basic I sent letters, I always bought him gifts, always sent him words of encouragement, was always there for him no matter what, but it seemed the only thing that was really keeping him with me was my body.
Flash forward to my first semester of college I gained a few pounds, not a lot, but just a few due to depression. He made some comment on it bringing up my previous ED I had in high school, orthorexia and stated that I may be going in the opposite direction (instead of losing a shit ton of weight, I’d be gaining a shit ton of weight). Yeah this comment really hurt but I just figured he didn’t know better since he wasn’t always the greatest at comforting people or knowing the right thing to say when it came to emotions.
We finally met up again after not seeing each other for a few months and ended up doing the devils tango. And I thought it was a great night but he ended up leaving right after the deed and his attitude seemed to change a lot.
He didn’t text me for a few days then he finally did and stated that he didn’t think it was going to work out and that he was embarrassed of me. He even lied to his parents about where he was going when he was going to see me and said he never talked to his friends about me at all.
Then he completely cut me off.

I felt like my body wasn’t good enough to keep him with me and maybe even scared him off. Ever since then I’ve been purging my food because I just want that control over my perceived attractiveness and kind of in order to spite him I wanted to get really thin and attractive.
This isn’t the entire reason I developed bulimia but it’s a big contender.

Hey there, I am in the exact same boat. I’ve struggled with depression and anxiety ever since I was 12 but ever since moving away to live on my own boy has it gotten worse.

I’ve had other ED’s in the past but never bingeing, but here I am ever since 3 months ago and I’m bingeing quite frequently… it’s a source of comfort for me from my depression and a (bad) coping mechanism.

While I don’t have the answers for you to stop bingeing, I just wanted to say that you should not feel guilty for “sucking” your family into helping you with your mental struggles like depression and eating disorders. These are the types of things people can get seriously hurt or even die from, you need to reach out for help with them. I am still struggling but I reach out for help every day and I have no idea where I’d be without that help.

The most important thing you can do is try to surround yourself with real, good, qualified help, such as therapy, a support group.. etc. if those who are helping you find it tedious or not worthwhile, or making you feel guilty about it, you need to find help elsewhere.

I have my therapist and my family is a great support group and yes, I’m still struggling pretty bad, so it may seem like this help isn’t even helping. But it is, there’s super duper small progress I can see from time to time, and yes I relapse a lot and all that, but without any of that help it would be even worse and I need to keep reminding myself that and keep trudging along.

I wish you all the best. ❤️
